d0-checks.json.meaning: chi2 at the fit's start values; sha256 of d0-fit.json from two passes of the bake

d0-chi2.json.meaning: dk-landscape src: chi2 bowl over (mu, width), minimiser path, dchi2 = 1/4 rings, 1D slice, dchi2 at PDG 1864.84 +- 0.04 on the slice

d0-cuts.json.meaning: IPchi2 < 9 counts with and without the TAU-missing rows; TAU > 0 count

d0-fit.json.meaning: the mass fit: start values, logged iterations (dk-curve params), result, pulls, window stability, PDG gap in sigma, mass/momentum scale shift, row 1 P(signal)

d0-hist.json.meaning: 2 MeV mass histograms over the full range (all, IPchi2 < 9, sum of P(signal)), the 45-bin fit range, row 1's bin

d0-means.json.meaning: window means of M (all, 1840-1890, 1850-1880, 1855-1875; centred on the fitted 1864.47 with half-widths 25/15/10/5; 1860-1870) and PDG

d0-psig.f32.meaning: P(signal) = S/(S+B) per candidate from the Gaussian+line fit (d0-fit.json), file order; outside 1820-1910 the fitted line is extrapolated and S is negligible

d0-tau.json.meaning: decay-time histograms in the window and sidebands (0.25 and 0.1 ps bins, with and without IPchi2 < 9), sideband-subtracted counts, the unbinned lifetime fit and its scans; plotSubtract: what dk-hist {subtract} leaves of the first 2 000 (and of all) in its seeded order

d0.f32.meaning: record 401 candidates in file order: M MeV/c2, PT MeV/c, TAU ps (NaN = missing), IPCHI2

d0.json.meaning: d0.f32's header: n, cols, units, row 1, value ranges, source block
